zh: 前缀是一个字符一个字符扩展出来的，每加一个字符只改变一个字母的次数；字母只有26个，每个前缀都可以直接检查谁是最高频。
维护26个字母的当前次数，以及每个字母成为最高频的累计次数；每加入一个字符后求出当前的最大次数，给所有次数等于它的字母（包括并列的）各加1。
遍历字符串：对应字母的次数加1；求26个次数中的最大值top；对每个次数等于top的字母，其累计值加1。遍历结束后输出26个累计值中的最大值。
en: Prefixes grow one character at a time, and each new character changes the count of just one letter; with only 26 letters you can check every prefix directly for who is most frequent.

Keep the current count of each of the 26 letters and how many times each letter has been most frequent; after adding a character, find the current maximum count and add 1 to every letter whose count equals it, ties included.

Walk the string: increase the count of the current letter; let top be the largest of the 26 counts; add 1 to the tally of every letter whose count equals top. At the end print the largest of the 26 tallies.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the 26 frequencies and the accumulated counts; each time a character is added, add one to every character tied for the highest frequency.

## Proof of correctness

The loop processes exactly all non-empty prefixes, and the frequencies equal the true counts in that prefix; checking one by one which counts equal the maximum implements exactly the definition with ties, and the result is the maximum of the accumulated counts.

## Complexity

Time O(26n), auxiliary space O(26).
